meta.subject: WEB_DEVELOPMENT
meta.author: bank-team-web-development
meta.attestation: authored from first principles; no protected content used

questions.topic: A label and the control it describes
questions.stem: A carpenter's form has a label with for='size'. Which control does it describe?

options.text: The control whose id is size
The control whose name is size
The first input on the page

questions.explanation: for matches the control's id. name, position, or form-wide scope do not determine the association.

questions.topic: Where a required field is enforced
questions.stem: A carpenter adds the required attribute to an input. Where is it enforced?
questions.explanation: required triggers browser validation before submission. Server validation is separate and still needed.

questions.topic: Tabs and spaces in source and in a preserved listing
questions.stem: A carpenter uses <pre> to show a cut list. What happens to tabs and spaces?
questions.explanation: pre preserves whitespace including tabs and spaces. Normal flow collapses them.

questions.topic: Why the initial box-sizing surprises people
questions.stem: A carpenter is surprised that width:100px with padding overflows. Explain why.

answer.exemplar: The default content-box counts only content in width, so padding and border add outside and overflow the declared width.

questions.explanation: Default box-sizing is content-box, so padding and border are added outside the declared width, causing overflow.

questions.topic: Which flex property works along the line and which across it
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish flex main and cross axis
questions.stem: A carpenter asks which flex property aligns items along the main axis. Which one?

options.misconception: confuses line packing with main axis

questions.explanation: justify-content distributes space along the main axis. align-items works on the cross axis.

questions.topic: What a media query changes and what it leaves alone
questions.stem: A carpenter's media query changes font-size at 600px. What else changes?

options.text: Only the rules inside the query

questions.explanation: A media query applies only its contained rules when the condition matches. It does not change markup or script state.

questions.topic: Breaking a tie between equally specific rules
questions.learningObjective: Resolve equal specificity by source order
questions.stem: A carpenter has two rules with equal specificity targeting the same element. Which wins?

options.text: The one with the shorter selector
The one appearing later in source

questions.explanation: When specificity ties, the later rule in source order wins. Selector length and property count are not tiebreakers.

questions.topic: Dividing a grid container between three fractional tracks
questions.stem: A carpenter sets grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr with 300px total. What is each track width?
questions.explanation: Three equal fr tracks split 300px into 100px each.

questions.topic: A fixed track beside a fractional one
questions.stem: A carpenter sets grid-template-columns: 100px 1fr with 300px total. What is the fr track width?
questions.explanation: The fractional track gets the remaining space: 300 - 100 = 200px.

questions.topic: Weighted shrinking along a flex line
questions.stem: A carpenter has two flex items with flex-shrink 1 and 1 on an overfull line. They shrink equally. If total overflow is 40px, how much does each shrink?
questions.explanation: Equal shrink factors split the overflow equally: 40/2 = 20px each.

questions.topic: Distributing free space with space-between
questions.stem: A carpenter uses justify-content:space-between on 3 items. Where is the first item?

options.text: At the end of the line
At the start of the line

questions.explanation: space-between puts the first item at the start and last at the end, distributing gaps between items. Edges have no gap.
questions.hint: First at start, last at end.

questions.topic: Counting the elements a descendant selector reaches
questions.stem: A carpenter's HTML has a div containing 3 paragraphs and 2 spans. How many elements does 'div p' match?
questions.explanation: The descendant selector matches all p elements inside the div, which is 3.

questions.topic: Choosing the winning declaration among three rules
questions.stem: A carpenter has three color rules with different specificities. Which applies?
questions.explanation: The most specific selector wins unless !important overrides. Source order only breaks ties.

questions.topic: Counting list items when an end tag is missing
questions.learningObjective: Predict parsing of omitted end tag
questions.stem:
A carpenter writes
  • one
  • two
. How many list items render?

options.misconception: assumes missing end tag merges items

questions.explanation: The parser auto-closes li when a new li starts, so two items render. Missing end tags are handled by the parser.

questions.topic: Margins that stop collapsing inside a flex container
questions.stem: A carpenter places two blocks inside a flex container. Do their vertical margins collapse?

options.text: No, because flex has no margins
No, flex containers prevent margin collapse

questions.explanation: Flex and grid containers establish formatting contexts where margins do not collapse between children.

questions.topic: Hiding an element without removing its space
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish visibility hidden from display none
questions.stem: A carpenter wants to hide an element but keep its space. Which property?

options.misconception: keeps interaction and may not hide from AT
moves rather than hides in place

questions.explanation: visibility:hidden keeps the box and space but hides rendering. display:none removes the box entirely.

questions.topic: Working out the shared space behind a fractional track
questions.learningObjective: Compute fr track with fixed siblings
questions.stem: A carpenter sets grid-template-columns: 1fr 2fr with 300px total. What is the second track width?
questions.explanation: The fr ratio 1:2 splits 300px into 100 and 200, so the second track is 200px.

questions.topic: An item that cannot shrink on an overfull line
questions.stem: A carpenter wants a flex item to never shrink. Which value?
questions.explanation: flex-shrink:0 prevents the item from shrinking. flex-grow, flex-basis, and shrink:1 do not.

questions.topic: Why a declared width is not the width on screen
questions.learningObjective: Explain box-sizing effect on rendered width
questions.stem: A carpenter declares width:100px but measures 120px on screen. Explain why.

answer.exemplar: Under the default content-box, padding and border are added outside the declared width, so the rendered box is wider.

questions.explanation: Default content-box excludes padding and border from width, so the rendered box exceeds the declared width.

questions.topic: The order from a document to painted boxes
questions.stem: A carpenter asks the order from HTML to painted pixels. Which sequence is right?
questions.explanation: The browser parses markup, computes layout, then paints. Other orders skip or reverse essential steps.

questions.topic: A label and the control it describes
questions.stem: A carpenter wraps an input inside a label. Is it associated?
questions.explanation: Wrapping a control inside a label creates an implicit association. for is not required in that case.

questions.topic: Where a required field is enforced
questions.stem: A carpenter relies only on required for security. Is this safe?

options.text: No, client validation can be bypassed

questions.explanation: Client-side required can be bypassed, so server-side validation is essential. HTTPS does not replace validation.

questions.topic: Tabs and spaces in source and in a preserved listing
questions.stem: A carpenter uses white-space:pre-wrap. What does it add over pre?
questions.explanation: pre-wrap preserves whitespace and also wraps long lines. pre does not wrap.

questions.topic: Why the initial box-sizing surprises people
questions.stem: A carpenter sets box-sizing:border-box globally. What problem does it solve?

options.text: It includes padding and border in width
It makes padding add outside width

questions.explanation: border-box includes padding and border in the declared width, preventing overflow surprises.

questions.topic: Which flex property works along the line and which across it
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish flex main and cross axis
questions.stem: A carpenter asks which flex property aligns items across the cross axis. Which one?
questions.explanation: align-items aligns items on the cross axis. justify-content is for the main axis.

questions.topic: What a media query changes and what it leaves alone
questions.stem: A carpenter's media query is not applying. Likely cause?

options.text: The CSS file is too large
The viewport meta tag is missing

questions.explanation: Without the viewport meta tag, mobile browsers may not apply media queries as expected. File size and HTML validity are not the cause.

questions.topic: Breaking a tie between equally specific rules
questions.learningObjective: Resolve equal specificity by source order
questions.stem: A carpenter's later rule is not winning despite equal specificity. Why might that be?

options.text: The later rule is in a different file
options.misconception: file origin is not the tiebreaker

options.text: Equal specificity always favors the first

questions.explanation: !important overrides source order. Selector length and file origin do not break specificity ties.

questions.topic: Dividing a grid container between three fractional tracks
questions.stem: A carpenter sets grid-template-columns: 2fr 2fr 2fr with 600px total. What is each track width?
questions.explanation: Three equal fr tracks split 600px into 200px each.

questions.topic: A fixed track beside a fractional one
questions.stem: A carpenter sets grid-template-columns: 50px 1fr with 250px total. What is the fr track width?
questions.explanation: The fractional track gets remaining space: 250 - 50 = 200px.

questions.topic: Weighted shrinking along a flex line
questions.stem: A carpenter has flex items with shrink factors 1 and 3 and overflow 40px. How much does the second item shrink?
questions.explanation: Shrink is proportional: 3/(1+3)*40 = 30px.

questions.topic: Distributing free space with space-between
questions.stem: A carpenter uses space-between with 2 items. Where are they placed?

options.text: One at start, one at end

questions.explanation: With two items, space-between places one at each end with no edge gaps.

questions.topic: Counting the elements a descendant selector reaches
questions.stem: A carpenter's HTML has a section containing 4 divs and 3 articles. How many elements does 'section div' match?
questions.explanation: The descendant selector matches the 4 divs inside the section.

questions.topic: Choosing the winning declaration among three rules
questions.stem: A carpenter adds !important to a low-specificity rule. Does it win?
questions.explanation: !important overrides normal specificity. It does not depend on order or inline status.

questions.topic: Counting list items when an end tag is missing
questions.learningObjective: Predict parsing of omitted end tag
questions.stem:
A carpenter writes
  1. one
  2. two
  3. three
. How many items render?
questions.explanation: The parser auto-closes each li, so three items render.

questions.topic: Margins that stop collapsing inside a flex container
questions.stem: A carpenter wants margin collapse between flex children. Is it possible?

options.text: No, flex children margins never collapse

questions.explanation: Flex containers prevent margin collapse among children regardless of direction or wrapping.

questions.topic: Hiding an element without removing its space
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish visibility hidden from display none
questions.stem: A carpenter uses visibility:hidden. Is the element still in the accessibility tree?

options.text: Yes, but only for screen readers
No, it is hidden from assistive tech
No, and it removes layout space

questions.explanation: visibility:hidden hides the element from assistive technologies and from rendering, while keeping layout space.

questions.topic: Working out the shared space behind a fractional track
questions.learningObjective: Compute fr track with fixed siblings
questions.stem: A carpenter sets grid-template-columns: 100px 1fr 1fr with 400px total. What is each fr track width?
questions.explanation: Remaining space is 400 - 100 = 300px, split equally: 150px each.

questions.topic: An item that cannot shrink on an overfull line
questions.stem: A carpenter sets min-width on a flex item. What effect does it have?

options.text: It prevents growing above that width
It prevents shrinking below that width

questions.explanation: min-width sets a lower bound on the item's width, preventing shrink below it. It does not affect growth or disable flex.

questions.topic: Why a declared width is not the width on screen
questions.learningObjective: Explain box-sizing effect on rendered width
questions.stem: A carpenter measures a border-box element with width:100px. What is its rendered width?
questions.explanation: border-box makes the declared width include padding and border, so the rendered width is 100px.

questions.topic: The order from a document to painted boxes
questions.stem: A carpenter asks what happens before layout in rendering. What is it?
questions.explanation: The browser parses and computes styles before layout. Painting, compositing, and rasterization come later.

questions.topic: A label and the control it describes
questions.stem: A carpenter clicks a label. What happens to its associated control?
questions.explanation: Clicking a label focuses its associated control. It does not disable or submit.

questions.topic: Where a required field is enforced
questions.stem: A carpenter wants custom required messaging. Best approach?

options.text: Use setCustomValidity or constraint validation API

questions.explanation: The constraint validation API supports custom messages. title, placeholder, and disabled do not.

questions.topic: Tabs and spaces in source and in a preserved listing
questions.stem: A carpenter uses white-space:nowrap. What happens to wrapping?
questions.explanation: nowrap prevents line wrapping. Spaces are preserved as in normal flow but lines do not break.

questions.topic: Why the initial box-sizing surprises people
questions.stem: A carpenter sets padding:0 to avoid overflow. Is that the only fix?

options.text: No, border-box or calc also work

questions.explanation: border-box or calc can accommodate padding without overflow. Removing padding is not the only option.

questions.topic: Which flex property works along the line and which across it
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish flex main and cross axis
questions.stem: A carpenter sets flex-direction:column. Which axis is main now?
questions.explanation: flex-direction:column makes the vertical axis the main axis. Horizontal becomes the cross axis.

questions.topic: What a media query changes and what it leaves alone
questions.stem: A carpenter's print media query changes colors. Does it affect screen display?

options.text: Yes, if no screen rule exists

questions.explanation: A print media query applies only in print context. Screen display uses screen or all rules.

questions.topic: Breaking a tie between equally specific rules
questions.learningObjective: Resolve equal specificity by source order
questions.stem: A carpenter's inline style and an !important rule conflict. Which wins?
questions.explanation: !important overrides even inline styles. Declarations do not merge on conflict.

questions.topic: Dividing a grid container between three fractional tracks
questions.stem: A carpenter sets grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 2fr with 400px total. What is the last track width?
questions.explanation: The ratio 1:1:2 splits 400px into 100, 100, 200.

questions.topic: A fixed track beside a fractional one
questions.stem: A carpenter sets grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr with 300px total. What is the first track width?
questions.explanation: The ratio 2:1 splits 300px into 200 and 100.

questions.topic: Weighted shrinking along a flex line
questions.stem: A carpenter has flex items with shrink factors 2 and 2 and overflow 60px. How much does each shrink?
questions.explanation: Equal shrink factors split overflow equally: 60/2 = 30px each.

questions.topic: Distributing free space with space-between
questions.stem: A carpenter uses space-between with 4 items. How many gaps between items?
questions.explanation: With 4 items there are 3 gaps between them; edges have no gap under space-between.

questions.topic: Counting the elements a descendant selector reaches
questions.stem: A carpenter's HTML has a nav containing 5 links and 2 buttons. How many elements does 'nav a' match?
questions.explanation: The descendant selector matches the 5 a elements inside nav.

questions.topic: Choosing the winning declaration among three rules
questions.stem: A carpenter has an inline style and a stylesheet rule of equal specificity. Which wins?
questions.explanation: Inline styles have higher priority than stylesheet rules of equal specificity.

questions.topic: Counting list items when an end tag is missing
questions.learningObjective: Predict parsing of omitted end tag
questions.stem:
A carpenter writes
  • one
  • two
. Is this valid?

options.text: No, ul must be closed by li

questions.explanation: Explicitly closing li makes the markup valid. No version restriction applies.

questions.topic: Margins that stop collapsing inside a flex container
questions.stem: A carpenter moves two blocks out of flex into normal flow. What changes about margins?

options.misconception: thinks normal flow has no margins

questions.explanation: In normal flow, adjoining vertical margins collapse. Flex prevented that collapse.

questions.topic: Hiding an element without removing its space
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish visibility hidden from display none
questions.stem: A carpenter wants to hide an element and remove its space. Which property?
questions.explanation: display:none removes the box and its space. visibility:hidden keeps space.

questions.topic: Working out the shared space behind a fractional track
questions.learningObjective: Compute fr track with fixed siblings
questions.stem: A carpenter sets grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr with 200px total. What is each track width?
questions.explanation: Four equal fr tracks split 200px into 50px each.

questions.topic: An item that cannot shrink on an overfull line
questions.stem: A carpenter sets flex:1 0 auto. What is the shrink factor?
questions.explanation: flex:1 0 auto sets grow 1, shrink 0, basis auto. The shrink factor is 0.

questions.topic: Why a declared width is not the width on screen
questions.learningObjective: Explain box-sizing effect on rendered width
questions.stem: A carpenter switches from content-box to border-box. Explain the visual change.

answer.exemplar: The declared width now includes padding and border, so the rendered box becomes narrower if padding and border were previously added outside.

questions.explanation: border-box includes padding and border in width, reducing the rendered box compared to content-box.

questions.topic: The order from a document to painted boxes
questions.stem: A carpenter asks whether JavaScript runs before or after initial paint. Which is common?

options.text: It can run before or after depending on loading

questions.explanation: Script loading and execution timing vary; scripts can block or run after paint depending on attributes and placement.
